convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for RD-TrendTrigger indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management, order execution, and new-bar detection. Custom indicator not available in Python backtesting frameworks.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total: minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec: chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

other_exits: In disposition mode: SELL_Close when Value[1]>LowLevel (oscillator returns above lower threshold)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 = 0.1 lots), positive values treated as deposit share fraction for risk-based sizing. Logic handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen.

custom_logic_notes: Two trading modes via AlgMode enum: 'twist' detects oscillator direction change (Value[2]>Value[1] for uptrend, Value[2]<Value[1] for downtrend) with entry on oscillator turning back (Value[1]<=Value[0] or Value[1]>=Value[0]). 'disposition' detects level breakthrough (Value[1]>HighLevel for buy, Value[1]<LowLevel for sell) with entry on cross above/below threshold. In twist mode, signal reversal automatically closes opposite positions (SellPosClose on buy signal, BuyPosClose on sell signal). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are input booleans gating each action. SignalBar=0 forces signal evaluation every tick; otherwise new-bar guard applies. Recount flag triggers recalculation on first run or after CopyBuffer failure.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate RD-TrendTrigger indicator (T3 smoothing with variable phase + linear regression) from its MQ5 source since it is a custom indicator. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) must be reimplemented: they handle position checking, lot sizing (negative MM=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), SL/TP in points, deviation, and order sending. The CIsNewBar class must also be reimplemented for bar-change detection. Disposition mode exit logic only generates SELL_Close (no explicit BUY_Close in that mode — buy exit is only via SL/TP).
